name: Handcrafted Antique Brass Thel Thulāva (තෙල් තුලාව)
description: Authentic artisan-cast solid brass Thel Thulāva oil pourer with classical Sri Lankan floral engravings and mythical dragon-spout. Designed for ceremonial oil pouring, Shirodhara therapy, and heritage collectors. Includes certificate of craftsmanship.

name: Artisanal Medicated Herbal Oil Collection (Hela Thailaya)
description: A set of three classical Sri Lankan medicated oils (Pinda Thailaya, Nilyadi Thailaya, and Maha Narayana Thailaya) prepared following ancient palm-leaf recipes with organic Ritigala herbs and sesame oil base. 100ml amber bottles.

name: Hand-Carved Stone & Wood Apothecary Mortar & Pestle
description: Traditional Sri Lankan stone mortar (Wangediya) and heavy jackwood pestle crafted by traditional blacksmiths and stone carvers. Essential for grinding herbal powders, roots, and kalka pastes without losing vital medicinal potency.

name: Sarartha Sangrahaya: Royal Medical Manuscript Replica
description: Archival reproduction of King Buddhadasa's 4th Century CE medical treatise written on cured palmyra leaves with an authentic wooden binding and brass stylus replica (Panhinda). A rare cultural collector's centerpiece.

name: Hela Herbal Wellness & Decoction Hamper
description: Premium curation of traditional Sri Lankan healing herbs: sun-dried Belimal flowers, Ranawara blossoms, Venivel bark, certified Paspanguwa packets, and wild bee honey sourced from indigenous Vedda communities.

name: Sanni Healing Mask Replica (Maha Kola)
description: Exquisite hand-carved Kaduru wood mask depicting the traditional ritual healing deities of southern Sri Lanka. Coloured with mineral pigments according to 300-year-old hereditary painting traditions.

name: Classical Temple Mural Fine Art Canvas
description: Archival fine art canvas reproduction of Kandyan-era temple ceiling murals. Hand-stretched onto sustainable timber frame with earth-toned mineral pigment highlights depicting celestial lotuses and guardian figures.

name: Artisanal Handwoven Dumbara Reed Tapestry
description: Authentic handloom reed mat crafted by master weavers of the Dumbara valley using locally cured Hana fiber and vegetal dyes. Features ancient geometric chevron motifs (Boku Rata) recognized by UNESCO.

name: Solid Brass Kandyan Ceremonial Oil Lamp (Pahana)
description: Hand-turned and etched solid brass ceremonial lamp featuring a majestic rooster crest, detachable oil reservoir with multiple wicks, and heavy engraved pedestal. Handcrafted by Pilimathalawa artisans.

name: Ambalangoda Hand-Carved Mayura Raksha Mask
description: Traditional southern Sri Lankan peacock demon mask hand-carved from seasoned Kaduru wood. Painted in vibrant non-toxic lacquers, traditionally hung at home entrances to ward off misfortune and invite prosperity.

name: Sigiriya & Sacred Landscapes Archival Monograph
description: Hardbound photographic and archaeological volume documenting ancient Sri Lankan water gardens, Ritigala forest sanctuaries, and rock fortress architecture with topographic fold-out maps.

name: Kandyan Geta Bera Artisan Miniature Drum
description: Traditional miniature double-headed Kandyan drum carved from seasoned Jackwood with monkey skin and cowhide acoustic membranes. Hand-tuned by hereditary percussionists from the central province.

name: Handmade Brass Ritual Incense Censer (Dummala Kalaya)
description: Authentic hand-cast solid brass ritual censer crafted in Pilimathalawa, designed for resinous incense (Dummala) fumigation in sacred Shanthikarma rituals and temple blessing rites.
